SELECT FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = '进行中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inProgressTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN DEADLINE < NOW() AND TASK_STATUS != '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overdueTasks, AVG(COMPLETION_PROGRESS) as avgProgress, AVG(QUALITY_SCORE) as avgQualityScore FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TASK_STATUS != '已完成' AND DEADLINE BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY DEADLINE ASC
SELECT FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND TASK_STATUS != '已完成' AND DEADLINE < NOW() ORDER BY DEADLINE ASC
SELECT TASK_STATUS as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY TASK_STATUS
SELECT PRIORITY as priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY PRIORITY
SELECT SUBMISSION_TYPE as submissionType, COUNT(*) as count FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY SUBMISSION_TYPE

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedTasks, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as completionRate FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CREATE_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT CASE WHEN QUALITY_SCORE >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN QUALITY_SCORE >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN QUALITY_SCORE >= 70 THEN '一般' WHEN QUALITY_SCORE >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END as scoreLevel, COUNT(*) as count FROM DATA_SUBMISSION_TASK WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND QUALITY_SCORE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scoreLevel
